title: Same-rule hammer control
normalExpectation: Hammering a nail drives it straight into wall.
impossibleRule: Every hammer strike causes the nail to bend away from the wall at a right angle; bending increases with force.
visibleTrigger: Kiko hits nail; it curves 90 degrees without entering wall.
whyThisObject: Hammer is meant to apply axial force to nail; if nail deflects under any force, it cannot penetrate.
goalRuleRelationship: The action to hang frame fails as nail never goes straight, preventing secure mounting.
frameZeroDescription: Kiko holds hammer mid-swing, but the nail protruding from the wall is bent into a U-shape, and the picture frame leans beside him.

beats.strategy: Kiko strikes the nail gently to hang the picture frame.
beats.visibleConsequence: The nail bends away from the wall; the picture frame drops to the floor.
beats.newInformation: A gentle hammer strike still bends the nail and blocks hanging.

beats.strategy: Kiko turns sideways and strikes the same nail from the other side.
beats.visibleConsequence: The nail bends away from the wall again; the picture frame slides farther down.
beats.newInformation: Changing the strike angle changes the hanging position but cannot seat the nail.

beats.strategy: Kiko moves the picture frame below the curved nail and strikes down.
beats.visibleConsequence: The nail bends farther away from the wall, pushing the picture frame onto the low shelf.
beats.newInformation: The low placement leaves the picture frame resting beneath the bent nail.

beats.strategy: Kiko places the picture frame on the shelf and gives the nail a final gentle strike.
beats.visibleConsequence: The nail bends away from the wall above the picture frame, leaving it standing on the shelf instead of hanging.
beats.newInformation: The picture frame is displayed on the shelf while the bent nail points over it.

finalPayoff: The nail bends away from the wall above the picture frame, leaving it standing on the shelf instead of hanging.
providerRationale: The hammer drives force into a nail; the same bending response defeats each placement.
